loopStart.description: The loop start position in seconds.

loopEnd.description: The loop end position in seconds.

offset.description: The playback start offset in seconds.

when.description: The scheduled start time in seconds.

duration.description: The requested playback duration in seconds.

priority.description: Playback priority where 0 is highest and 256 is lowest.

channelInterpretation.description: The channel interpretation applied when graph processing needs one.

oscillator.description: Procedural waveform for a source without an 'audio' property. A source MUST NOT declare both audio and oscillator. loop/loopStart/loopEnd/offset/playbackRate are ignored for oscillator sources.
